headline: How LinkedIn, Netflix & DoorDash Run Agents, Evals & Inference at Scale in Production
summary: QCon AI New York 2026's program highlights how major tech companies like LinkedIn, Netflix, and DoorDash are operationalizing AI agents in production environments. Sessions cover real-world architectures for running agentic systems, building robust evaluation (evals) pipelines, and managing inference at scale — moving beyond prototypes to production-grade AI infrastructure.
why_it_matters: As an AI Engineer working with ServiceNow and LLM applications, this is directly relevant to your work and career trajectory toward AI Application Engineer. These case studies offer concrete patterns for production agent architecture, eval frameworks, and inference optimization that you can apply or benchmark against in your own LLM application work.

headline: Apple Research Unveils Faster Retrieval Method for More Efficient RAG
summary: Apple's machine learning research team has published new findings on improving retrieval speed in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, aiming to make RAG pipelines both faster and more efficient without sacrificing quality.
why_it_matters: RAG is a core building block for many LLM applications, including enterprise tools built on platforms like ServiceNow. Faster, more efficient retrieval techniques could directly improve the performance and cost-efficiency of systems you build or maintain, making this valuable technical knowledge for your AI engineering work.

headline: Google Launches Gemini Decisions API with Gemini Decision 1 at $0.10/M Tokens
summary: Google has introduced a new Gemini Decisions API featuring the Gemini Decision 1 model, priced at $0.10 per million tokens. The API is designed to support decision-making and agentic workflows at a low cost point, potentially broadening access to affordable agent infrastructure.
why_it_matters: Low-cost decision-making APIs are highly relevant for building scalable LLM-powered applications, especially in enterprise contexts like ServiceNow integrations where cost efficiency matters. This could be a tool worth evaluating for agentic features in your projects.

headline: GitHub Makes Agentic Workflows Generally Available with Isolation and Budget Controls
summary: GitHub has announced general availability of agentic workflows, now including isolation mechanisms and budget controls to help manage cost and security risks when running autonomous AI agents within development pipelines.
why_it_matters: As you move toward building more sophisticated LLM applications, understanding how platforms like GitHub are addressing agent isolation and cost control provides practical guardrail patterns applicable to your own agentic system designs, especially in enterprise environments.

headline: JioHotstar Benchmarks Knowledge Bases for AI Coding Agents
summary: JioHotstar has published benchmarking results comparing different knowledge base and retrieval strategies specifically for AI coding agents, offering insights into which approaches yield the best performance for code-related AI assistance tasks.
why_it_matters: If you're incorporating AI coding agents into your workflow or building developer-facing tools, these benchmarks can help inform decisions about knowledge base design and retrieval strategy, directly supporting your growth as an AI Application Engineer.
